skills.name: Convert to Common Denominator
skills.definition: Convert fractions to a common denominator, including finding the least common denominator and generating equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract Fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Simplify Fractions
skills.definition: Reduce fractions to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Handle Mixed Numbers
skills.definition: Interpret and manipulate mixed numbers, including separating whole and fraction parts, rewriting whole numbers as mixed numbers with zero fraction, converting improper fraction parts to proper form, and subtracting whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrow
skills.definition: Borrow from the whole part when fraction subtraction yields a negative result, by decreasing the whole by 1 and adding the denominator to the fraction before subtracting.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominator
skills.definition: The ability to subtract the numerators of two fractions with the same denominator and keep the denominator.

skills.name: Find common denominator and convert fractions
skills.definition: The ability to find a common denominator (usually the least common denominator) and convert fractions to equivalent forms with that denominator.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: The ability to reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Borrow from whole number
skills.definition: The ability to borrow 1 from the whole part of a mixed number, convert it to a fraction with the same denominator, and add it to the fraction part before subtracting.

skills.name: Convert improper fraction in mixed number
skills.definition: The ability to simplify a mixed number by carrying over an improper fraction part to the whole number.

skills.name: Rewrite whole number as mixed number
skills.definition: The ability to express a whole number as a mixed number with a fraction part of zero over a given denominator.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: The ability to subtract integers.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two fractions and convert each to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator, keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract the integer parts of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: When the fraction part of the minuend is less than the fraction part of the subtrahend, borrow one from the whole part, convert it to a fraction with the common denominator, add to the fraction part, and then subtract.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Interpret mixed numbers
skills.definition: Recognize that a mixed number is the sum of a whole number and a fraction, and separate them; also treat a whole number as a mixed number with a zero fraction.

skills.name: Separate whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Decompose a mixed number or a whole number into its integer part and a fraction part, treating a whole number as having a zero fraction with the appropriate denominator.

skills.name: Find common denominator and convert fractions
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator (LCD) of two fractions and convert each to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Perform subtraction of the integer parts of two numbers.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with like denominators
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that share the same denominator, writing the result over that denominator.

skills.name: Borrow from whole number
skills.definition: When the fraction part of the minuend is less than the fraction part of the subtrahend, reduce the whole part by 1 and add the value of one whole (as denominator/denominator) to the fraction part, then subtract.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Handle whole numbers
skills.definition: Identify and separate the whole number part from the fraction part of a mixed number or whole number, perform subtraction on the whole number parts, and combine the resulting whole number with the fraction part to form the final answer.

skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator (LCD) of two fractions and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator and write the result as a fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Borrow from whole
skills.definition: Recognize that the fraction part of the result is negative, and perform the borrowing operation: reduce the whole part by 1, add the denominator to the numerator of the minuend's fraction, then subtract the subtrahend's fraction again; repeat if necessary.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.
